readings.why: The search field above the queue now contains "invoice" and the list has narrowed from seven rows to the single TQ-101 row with the header count changing from (7) to (1), with no search button anywhere in the UI.

The caption from beat-06 onward asserts that part of a requester's name finds that person's tickets, but the only query ever typed under it is "webhook" (beat-10), a word from the ticket title, so nothing on screen shows a name or address matching the requester field - only the caption says so.
